expr: (() => { const S=window.simState, s=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select'); return S.co2===420 && s[0].value==='420' && s[1].value==='1' && S.Teq===15 && S.nopeus===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: nykyinen määrä 420 ppm, settles at +15 °C, speed normaali (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const o=(i)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')[i].options].map(x=>x.value+':'+x.textContent).join('|'); return document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select').length===2 && o(0)==='0:ei kasvihuonekaasuja|280:esiteollinen määrä|420:nykyinen määrä|560:hiilidioksidia kaksinkertaisesti' && o(1)==='0.5:hidas|1:normaali|2:nopea' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: two selects: four levels by CO2 ppm, speed hidas · normaali · nopea
DOM order canvas, controls, readout; no slider

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).join(',')==='co2' ? 1 : 0 })()
(() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); return c.width===600 && c.height===400 ? 1 : 0; })()

(() => { const L=window.simState.labels.map(l=>l.s).join('|'); return L.includes('\\text{Aurinko}') && L.includes('\\text{ilmakehä}') && L.includes('\\text{maanpinta}') && L.includes('-18\\,{}^\\circ\\text{C}') && L.includes('+15\\,{}^\\circ\\text{C}') && L.includes('$+15\\,{}^\\circ\\text{C}') && L.includes('\\text{CO}_2') && L.includes('\\text{H}_2\\text{O}') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: canvas labels (LaTeX): Sun, atmosphere, ground, thermometer marks and value, molecule key
one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.T < 15 && S.T > -18 && S.tila==='jaahtyy' ? 1 : 0 })()
